interface.shortDescription: Look up domain registration, check availability, fetch DNS records, and resolve IPs and ASNs via RDAP and DNS-over-HTTPS via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.
interface.longDescription: Look up domain registration, check availability, fetch DNS records, and resolve IPs and ASNs via RDAP and DNS-over-HTTPS. Six tools: whois_lookup_domain (full registration record), whois_check_availability (RDAP 404 = available), whois_get_dns (A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CNAME, SOA, CAA, PTR), whois_lookup_ip (netblock, org, abuse contact, PTR), whois_lookup_asn (ASN to org/RIR), and whois_get_dossier (one-call domain triage). IANA bootstrap auto-routes each query to the correct RDAP server; no API keys required. Runs over stdio or Streamable HTTP.
